يحتجز (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِزُ (yaḥtajizu) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يُحْتَجَزُ (yuḥtajazu) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يَحْتَجِزَ (yaḥtajiza) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.za/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
